items.claim: Musayev is 36 years old with 30 fights, resulting in significant wear and tear.
items.quote: this guy's 36 years old. This guy has 30 fights. A lot of wear and tear.

items.claim: Musayev does not have the best cardio.
items.quote: I don't think he has the best cardio.

items.claim: Musayev's durability is waning a bit.
items.quote: I think his durability is waning a bit.

items.claim: Musayev is very poor on the mat and makes many mistakes in grappling.
items.quote: this guy's a a wipeout on the mat... Musayev's grappling just makes so many mistakes in the grappling.

items.claim: Klein is the younger fighter and is better everywhere.
items.quote: Klein's obviously the younger guy. Klein's going to be better everywhere in my opinion.

items.claim: Musayev might have more power than Klein.
items.quote: Musayev might have more power, maybe maybe has more power

items.claim: Klein is more durable than Musayev.
Klein has grappling skills and has previously won fights by various submissions including guillotines, an armbar, and rear-naked chokes.
items.quote: Klein has some grappling in his back pocket... he has like eight eight seven or eight submissions. He has a lot of guillotines. He has like an armbar. A rear naked choke or two.

items.claim: Klein has not secured a submission win in approximately the last 9 years.
items.quote: he doesn't have a submission win in like the last since like the last 9 years

items.claim: Musayev has only been knocked out once, but has been hurt a lot and takes a lot of damage.
items.quote: Musayev, although only knocked out once, he's been hurt a lot. He's been taking a lot of damage.
